sections.Profile:
The "Frontiersman" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, four standup targets, and a gobble hole.
